implementation: Locally authored for this delivery; the requested external tool/skill was unavailable. This is not an official certification.

rubric.rule: Start at100 and deduct the entire category weight on failure. Every category is also a hard gate; each clip must exceed88. No score is assigned for subjective basketball aesthetics.

method.playback: Fresh Three.js AnimationMixer of actual delivered GLB; no live IK modifies the tested model.
method.sampleRate: All30Hz main-clip frames and interval quarter/mid/three-quarter interpolation samples; bridge derivatives measured with one-sided0.1ms finite differences.
method.footSlip: Horizontal world displacement of a fixed local foot marker per contiguous declared full-support window, independent of solver target positions.
method.hands: Actual transformed palmar markers plus all vertices weighted>50% to the contacting hand; vertex distances do not establish continuous triangle collision.
method.bridgeScope: All96 explicit standing/running ingress/egress bridges; skeletal translation/rotation and grip morph endpoint derivatives. Free-flight ball visibility may change; no ball C1 claim is inferred.

limitations: Numeric score assesses export integrity, authored contacts, support drift, transitions and bake fidelity. Professional basketball technique remains a visual/coaching judgement.
The18-joint rig has no finger joints; independent hand grip morphs deform fingers.

Planted-foot declarations are authored metadata; actual interpolation support and hand contact is checked where both adjacent authored samples declare contact. This finite120Hz sampling does not prove continuous collision freedom.
Vertex-based contact tests sample vertices, not continuous mesh collision.

Approximate anthropometric COM uses nominal segment fractions and a geometric shoe hull. Dynamic stability, forces and athlete-specific mass distribution are not measured. No gameplay integration, physical phone performance, motion-capture provenance or coach approval is established.

trajectory.method: One-sided0.1ms derivatives of the actual delivered ball track. Extrapolated C0 uses disjoint sample pairs on each side. Finite-difference C1 is observed rather than assumed from authoring metadata.

balance.model: Approximate human segment-mass COM projected onto the convex hull of actual supported shoe vertices; not a force-plate or dynamic-stability model.
